name: Da Lat food guide
summary: Morning is bánh căn off a charcoal pan or a hot bowl of pork-meatball broth with a grilled baguette. Later, lá é chicken hotpot, cold avocado ice cream, and strawberries with sweet milk on the market slope.
body: Da Lat eats from the slope above Xuan Huong Lake and from the stalls in the centre. Morning can be a hot bowl of bánh mì xíu mại, bánh căn off a charcoal pan, or soft rice sheets with chicken. Afternoon is avocado ice cream, eaten cold while you stand. After dark the night market grills a rice sheet and pours sweet hot soy milk.

The farms set the table: avocado, strawberry, asparagus, artichoke, grape, tea, coffee, and wild mountain mushrooms. Cooks here also change the dishes people brought with them. Mì Quảng, bún bò Huế, Hanoi-style phở with lettuce, bánh bèo, bánh xèo, and Phan Rang chicken rice are those other plates.
The coast is a different meal. Nha Trang and Mui Ne are a few hours away by car.
specialtiesLead: Charcoal bánh căn, hot xíu mại, market fruit, artichoke tea, and the persimmons, then the night stalls, lá é hotpot, bánh ướt lòng gà, and clay-pot rice.

sections.heading: Market snacks
paragraphs: Cups, sheets, and jars from the market slope, the night stalls, and the orchards.

spots.name: Avocado ice cream
spots.address: Market slope, the night market, and 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi
spots.note: Blended avocado dessert, eaten cold from a cup. In Da Nang it is in the Con Market snack row.

spots.name: Grilled rice paper
spots.note: A crisp rice sheet grilled with toppings, folded and eaten from the paper.

spots.name: Strawberry with condensed milk
spots.note: Fresh strawberries with sweet milk, in a cup or a bag.

spots.name: Hot soy milk
spots.address: Market, the night market, and 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ
spots.note: Sweet hot soy milk for a cool evening, carried in a cup.

spots.name: Artichoke tea
spots.note: Herbal tea from local artichoke, drunk hot or bottled to take home.

spots.name: Crab soup
spots.address: Night market and Lam Vien Square
spots.note: Hot crab soup for a cold night at the night market and Lam Vien Square.

spots.name: Grilled skewers
spots.note: Skewers from the night-market stalls, eaten there under the lights.

spots.name: Yaourt phô mai
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Yersin, Hoàng Diệu, and Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: Yaourt phô mai beside the bánh căn, and a yaourt beside the morning xíu mại bowls.

spots.name: Bánh flan phô mai
spots.note: Cheese flan after the bánh căn.

spots.name: Wind-dried persimmon
spots.note: Persimmons hung in controlled wind until they are very sweet, chewy, and fragrant.

spots.name: Dried persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass, and shops in town
spots.note: Persimmon dried in the open air or cold-dried until chewy, a fragrant highland sweet.

spots.name: Soft ripe persimmon
spots.note: Soft ripe persimmon from the orchards on Mimosa Pass.

spots.name: Pressed persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass, or a shop in town
spots.note: Pressed persimmon from the orchards on Mimosa Pass.

spots.name: Crunchy persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass and Cau Dat orchards
spots.note: Crunchy persimmon from the orchards, sweet and aromatic. Freshly picked fruit is also called sweet, soft, and juicy.

spots.name: Strawberry jam
spots.note: Mildly sweet, fragrant strawberry jam.

spots.name: Candied ginger
spots.note: Candied ginger from the market fringe, beside the fruit preserves, coffee, and artichoke tea.

spots.name: Fruit preserves
spots.note: Fruit preserves from the market fringe, the jars Da Lat is known for, set out with candied ginger, coffee, and artichoke tea.

spots.name: Da Lat wine
spots.note: Wine made in Da Lat from local grapes and specialty fruit.

spots.name: Da Lat strawberries
spots.note: Fresh strawberries from the Da Lat farms, the fruit on its own rather than the condensed-milk cup.

spots.name: Artichoke extract
spots.note: Cooked-down artichoke, a Lam Dong product separate from the artichoke tea.

sections.heading: Cooked specialties
paragraphs: The plates for a day in town, from the charcoal cakes and the morning bowl to the hotpot and the clay pot.

spots.name: Bánh căn
spots.note: Bite-size rice cakes grilled over charcoal, with a quail egg or a duck egg on top. At Lệ the shell is crisp, and one dip is an onion sauce.

spots.name: Bánh mì xíu mại
spots.address: 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: A hot breakfast bowl of pork-meatball broth, with a grilled baguette, shredded papaya, and herbs.

spots.name: Bánh ướt lòng gà
spots.address: Phan Đình Phùng and Tăng Bạt Hổ
spots.note: White, soft, chewy rice sheets with shredded chicken, breast bone, thigh, offal, and trứng non. The fish sauce is not overly salty, and chili is there if you want heat.

spots.name: Lẩu gà lá é
spots.address: 3 Tháng 4, Chu Văn An, and Yersin
spots.note: Chicken hotpot with lá é, a leaf that looks like cinnamon and smells like lemongrass. At Tao Ngộ the broth is fragrant and hot with chili, and the gà ta is firm and sweet.

spots.name: Cơm niêu
spots.address: Hồ Tùng Mậu, Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, and Sương Nguyệt Ánh
spots.note: Clay-pot rice with a thin crust, served with the house braises and vegetables.

spots.name: Cơm lam
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Bamboo-tube rice with sesame salt. The sweetness is attributed to upstream water, and the smell to young bamboo.

spots.name: Nem nướng
spots.address: 5 Trần Phú and 45 Bùi Thị Xuân
spots.note: Grilled pork with bánh tráng phơi sương, fresh herbs, and a sauce mixed in the shop. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.

spots.name: Bánh giò
spots.address: 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: A small cake beside the bánh mì xíu mại bowls.

spots.name: Chả cây
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Yersin, Hoàng Diệu, and Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: Chả cây beside the bánh căn, and a chả beside the morning xíu mại, kept as two names.

spots.name: Gà nướng lu
spots.note: Chicken roasted in a lu, beside the lá é hotpot.

spots.name: Lòng gà xào nấm
spots.note: Chicken offal stir-fried with mushrooms, on the same menu as the lá é hotpot.

spots.name: Grilled forest meat
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Grilled forest meat with the bamboo-tube rice.

spots.name: Grilled chicken
spots.address: Langbiang side, Cu Lan, and 7 Tô Hiến Thành
spots.note: Grilled chicken with cơm lam toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan, and on the chicken menu at 7 Tô Hiến Thành.

spots.name: Grilled chicken eggs
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Chicken eggs grilled beside the bamboo-tube rice.

spots.name: Stuffed snails
spots.note: Snails stuffed with meat, the specialty at 33 Hai Bà Trưng.

spots.name: Oxtail hotpot
spots.note: Oxtail hotpot at 33 Hai Bà Trưng.

spots.name: Chicken herbal stew
spots.note: Chicken stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Pigeon herbal stew
spots.note: Pigeon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Beef-tendon herbal stew
spots.note: Beef tendon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Pork-tendon herbal stew
spots.note: Pork tendon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Pork-brain herbal stew
spots.note: Pork brain stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Ngọc hành herbal stew
spots.note: Ngọc hành stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.

spots.name: Artichoke with pork hock
spots.note: Artichoke stewed with pork hock, served with the clay-pot rice.

spots.name: Lẩu tả pín lù
spots.note: Lẩu tả pín lù beside the clay-pot rice.

spots.name: Boiled chicken
spots.note: Boiled gà ta.

spots.name: Chicken steamed with fish sauce
spots.note: Chicken steamed with fish sauce.

spots.name: Tile-grilled meat
spots.note: Meat grilled on a tile.

sections.heading: Regional dishes
paragraphs: Central dishes came with people who moved here, and the kitchens change them for the weather and the farms. Phan Rang chicken rice is the other plate those accounts place in town.

spots.name: Bánh bèo
spots.address: 68 Phan Đình Phùng, and streetside stalls
spots.note: A Hue cake of rice and tapioca, steamed in a small bowl, with light fish sauce, fried shallots, chili, and crispy pork skin. The street-lunch plate adds river shrimp.

spots.name: Bánh xèo
spots.note: Bánh xèo as cooked in Da Lat, also on the board beside the nem nướng at 45 Bùi Thị Xuân.

spots.name: Bún bò Huế
spots.address: Phù Đổng Thiên Vương, Hồ Tùng Mậu, and the market fountain
spots.note: A hot morning bowl with beef, black sauce, and satay chili. About 35,000 VND at 1c Phù Đổng Thiên Vương, and 30,000–40,000 VND at 2 Hồ Tùng Mậu. Ấp Ánh Sáng sits by the fountain in front of Da Lat Market.

spots.name: Phở bò
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ and Nguyễn Văn Cừ
spots.note: Hanoi-style phở with herbs and crisp lettuce. 30,000–45,000 VND at 23 Tăng Bạt Hổ, and 25,000–30,000 VND at 2/8 Nguyễn Văn Cừ.

spots.name: Mì Quảng
spots.address: Upper floor of Da Lat Market
spots.note: Turmeric noodles in a pork-knuckle broth, assembled through the day on the upper floor of the market.

spots.name: Cơm gà Phan Rang
spots.note: Phan Rang chicken rice at 28 Trần Nhật Duật.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The day market is the slope above the lake, flowers and produce in the morning. The night market is in the centre, about 18:00–23:00, with grilled rice paper, soy milk, and skewers.

spots.name: Da Lat Market
spots.caption: Morning produce and strawberries on the slope above the lake.
spots.note: Morning flowers, produce, and strawberry cups on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake.

spots.name: Da Lat Night Market
spots.caption: Lit counters for grilled rice paper and soy milk.
spots.note: Grilled rice paper, hot soy milk, and skewers under the lights, about 18:00–23:00.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: The hot Da Lat breakfast is bánh mì xíu mại, small bowls of pork-meatball broth with the grilled baguette on the side. A bánh mì is the morning sandwich from a street counter near the market.

seoTitle: Da Lat food guide — bánh căn, xíu mại, lá é hotpot
seoDescription: Da Lat food: charcoal bánh căn, hot xíu mại, lá é chicken hotpot, market fruit, and persimmon.
